name: Tesseract Native Inverse Kinematics
description: Return the exact native Tesseract IK result, including an empty solution list.

inputParameters.name: planner
inputParameters.description: TesseractPlanner from Tesseract Planner. Only inverse_kinematics_native is used.

inputParameters.name: target
inputParameters.description: Exact COMPAS FAB FrameTarget to solve.

inputParameters.name: robot_cell_state
inputParameters.description: Exact RobotCellState supplying the native IK seed.

inputParameters.name: group
inputParameters.description: Optional planning-group name. Unconnected uses the cell main group.

inputParameters.name: ik_solver_name
inputParameters.description: Optional exact native IK plugin name. Unconnected uses the configured default.

outputParameters.name: result
outputParameters.description: Exact TesseractInverseKinematicsResult wrapper retaining every native object.

outputParameters.name: target_pose
outputParameters.description: Exact native target Pose in robot-relative metres.

outputParameters.name: native_input
outputParameters.description: Exact native KinGroupIKInput submitted to the selected solver.

outputParameters.name: group
outputParameters.description: Resolved planning-group name used by the native solve.

outputParameters.name: solutions
outputParameters.description: Every native solution array in solver order; empty when no solution exists.
